paragraphs.text: Finneas is a rabbitfolk archer from Goodhill on Bloomburrow , and a member of Mabel’s party .

Finneas is a sable-furred rabbitfolk farmer who usually wears a wide straw hat. An accomplished archer, Finneas has won the spring and autumn archery competitions of Goodhill too many times and been subsequently banned from participating.

Finneas comes from a long line of Goodhill farmers. He was a coddled child in a big family who grew up fast in the safety of his hometown. At first, archery was meant to be a time waster, but once his mother saw him nearly hit a target, she set him up with every manner of lesson she could. Since then, Finneas has always known he'd be a star archer or else he'd let his mother down. He set his sights on joining the Pawpatch Party, a group of rabbitfolk dedicated to protecting Valley from threats, but his heart was set on an adventure away from the watchful eye of his family.

When Mabel ventured to Pondside to investigate the Calamity Beast incursions in around 4564 AR , Finneas excitedly volunteered to accompany her, despite his sisters’ protest. he knew his bow would come in handy, though he couldn't know how tough the quest would be. He he had great expectations to live up to, but his mother said he was ready to take on the world. Gev , Hugs , Zoraline and Helga also joined the party . Finneas was first to volunteer.
At Three Trees City , Finneas helped Mabel ask around to see if anyone had seen the squirrelfolk necromancers they encountered previously.
